messages:
meg (Marketing): Heads-up: benchmark report + webinar next Thu. Need tight social plan for X + LinkedIn: hero post, two reminders, 4-tweet highlights thread, and a post-webinar clip + sign-up follow-up. Also need lead routing details.

kai (Social): Draft cadence: Thu 10:00 PT hero, Mon 09:00 reminder (data nugget), Wed 11:00 reminder (speakers + CTA), Thu AM day-of push, Fri follow-up + clip. Will make tech + product copy variants.

jules (Design): I can deliver hero PNG + square crop + 8s MP4 clip by EOD tomorrow. Which palette?

meg (Marketing): Blue for LinkedIn, charcoal for X. Include speaker headshots for the hero.

kai (Social): Copy drafts:
- X (technical): "New inference benchmark: latency vs cost across open models. Join our webinar for methodology and ops tips. Register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=bench_jul"
- X (human): "We ran a big inference benchmark and found practical ways to cut cost. Live webinar Thu — limited seats: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"
- LinkedIn: short paragraph outlining methodology, speakers, CTA.

ada (Growth): Paid boost: recommend hero + Wed reminder. Budget ask: $900 targeting ML infra and platform engs. I'll share audiences.

noah (SDR): Routing: send signups to SFDC queue "Bench_Webinar_Leads". Include hidden fields: lead_source=bench_jul, company_size, use_case. SDRs will triage within 48h.

kai (Social): I'll append UTMs to registration links and pin a reply with speaker bios. Live-reply owner for first hour?

ada (Growth): I'll own the first hour replies and pass high-intent leads to Noah.

jules (Design): Uploaded assets -> https://files.redwood.ai/bench/jul_assets.zip. Square + 16:9 included.

kai (Social): Final checklist: approve copy variants, attach hero image, confirm paid budget. React with :thumbsup: when you complete your action.

meg (Marketing): Approve technical X for dev channel and human X for product channel. LinkedIn copy approved. Budget approved pending final audience list.

ada (Growth): :thumbsup: will post audience list by EOD.

noah (SDR): :thumbsup: will prep outreach template.

jules (Design): :thumbsup:
